templates.name: Abandoned browse email
templates.description: Sends an email to a customer who viewed products but left without purchasing, reminding them of the last items they browsed. Content selection from an aggregate of the customer's last viewed products is a Bloomreach asset built outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer views a product and leaves without purchasing within the session window, send a browse-abandonment email showing their last viewed items.

default_requirements.note: Product image for the email template.

templates.name: Abandoned cart email with recommendations
templates.description: Sends a personalized email to customers who leave items in their cart, showing those items plus AI-recommended products to lift order value. The recommendation engine and evaluation dashboard are Bloomreach assets configured outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer adds a product to their cart and does not check out, send an abandoned-cart email with the cart items and recommended products.

default_requirements.note: Suppresses the email once checkout has started.

templates.name: Abandoned search email flow
templates.description: Targets customers who searched for flights, hotels or rentals but did not complete a booking, re-engaging them with a follow-up email built from the last search or last viewed item. Choosing between the aggregate-based or event-based content flow is configured in Bloomreach.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer searches or views a travel item without booking within the session window, send an abandoned-search email with the last searched or viewed item.

templates.name: Automated favorite brand newsletter with new items
templates.description: Sends a weekly newsletter promoting new products from the customer's favorite brand, determined from their purchase and view history. The brand-affinity recommendation engine itself runs in Bloomreach, outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For customers with enough purchase or view history, send a weekly newsletter of new items from their favorite brand.

templates.name: Automated newsletter for new items of interest
templates.description: Sends a weekly newsletter recommending new items from the product category a customer views most, based on category_level_1 seen on view_item. Category ranking and product selection run in a Bloomreach aggregate and recommendation engine outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For customers who repeatedly view items in one category without buying from it, send a weekly newsletter of new items in that category.

templates.name: Automated price drop alert email for items in cart
templates.description: Alerts a customer by email when the price of an item left in their cart drops, comparing the price recorded on add_to_cart with the current catalog price. Price-drop detection runs as a Bloomreach evaluation outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When the catalog price of a product in a customer's cart drops below the price recorded on add_to_cart, send a price-drop email.

templates.name: Automated price drop email alert
templates.description: Alerts a customer by email when the price of a product they viewed drops, comparing the price recorded on view_item with the current catalog price. Price-drop detection runs as a Bloomreach evaluation outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When the catalog price of a viewed product drops below the price recorded on view_item, send a price-drop email.

templates.name: Automated restock email alert
templates.description: Notifies a customer by email when an out-of-stock product they viewed becomes available again, using stock_level recorded on view_item. Stock-level change detection runs as a Bloomreach evaluation outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a viewed out-of-stock product's stock_level becomes available, send a restock email.

templates.name: Bi-weekly product recommendation newsletter
templates.description: Sends a bi-weekly newsletter of personalized product recommendations built from purchase and browsing history. The recommendation engine and cadence are configured in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: Every two weeks, send a newsletter of personalized product recommendations to customers with newsletter consent.

templates.name: Birthday campaign
templates.description: Sends a personalized birthday email with an offer around the customer's birthday, using the customer's stored birthday. Offer content and send-time logic are configured in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: Around a customer's birthday, send a personalized birthday email with an offer.

templates.name: Personalized abandoned cart email
templates.description: Sends a personalized abandoned-cart email listing exactly the items a customer left behind, without a recommendations engine. Email design personalization runs in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer abandons a cart without checking out, send a personalized email listing the abandoned items.

default_requirements.note: Suppresses the email once checkout has started.

templates.name: Post-cancellation follow-up email flow
templates.description: Sends a follow-up email after a customer cancels a booking, offering alternatives or collecting feedback based on the returned purchase's status. Alternative recommendations are a Bloomreach asset built outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a booking's purchase_status changes to cancelled, send a follow-up email with alternatives.

templates.name: Post-holiday feedback
templates.description: Sends a post-trip feedback survey email after a completed booking, timed from the purchase event. Survey scoring and evaluation dashboards run in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: After a purchase completes and the trip ends, send a feedback survey email.

templates.name: Post-purchase email with recommendations
templates.description: Sends a post-purchase email recommending follow-on products, based on the purchased items and a Bloomreach recommendation engine. The engine and evaluation dashboard are configured outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: After a purchase completes, send an email with recommended follow-on products.

templates.name: Post-purchase NPS survey email
templates.description: Sends a Net Promoter Score survey email after a purchase completes, to measure satisfaction. Score aggregation and reporting run in a Bloomreach dashboard outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: After a purchase completes, send an NPS survey email.

templates.name: Pre-travel engagement email flow
templates.description: Sends a series of engagement emails ahead of a customer's booked trip, using the booking's purchase date. Content timing relative to the trip date is configured in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: In the days before a booked trip, send a pre-travel engagement email with trip details.

templates.name: Purchase anniversary recommendations
templates.description: Sends a yearly email around the anniversary of a customer's purchase, recommending new products. Anniversary date computation and the recommendation engine run in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: Around the anniversary of a customer's purchase, send an email with new product recommendations.

templates.name: Reactivation campaign for disengaged email subscribers
templates.description: Sends a win-back email to subscribers who stopped opening or clicking campaigns, aiming to restore engagement before they lapse further. Engagement scoring runs in a Bloomreach evaluation outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a subscriber's email engagement drops below the reactivation threshold, send a win-back email.

templates.name: Reactivation campaign for lapsing and lapsed customers
templates.description: Sends a reactivation email to customers who have not purchased in a defined period, split into lapsing and lapsed segments by purchase recency. Segmentation runs in a Bloomreach evaluation outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer's time since their last purchase crosses the lapsing or lapsed threshold, send a reactivation email.

templates.name: Refer-a-friend campaign
templates.description: Invites existing customers to refer friends in exchange for a reward, triggered after a purchase and sent to their email address. Referral link generation and reward issuance run in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: After a purchase, invite the customer to refer a friend for a reward.

templates.name: Refill reminder email campaign
templates.description: Reminds a customer to reorder a consumable product after the expected usage period following their purchase, using the purchased item's product_id. Refill-interval configuration per product runs in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: After the expected usage period following a purchase of a consumable item, send a refill reminder email.

templates.name: Retention campaign for repeat purchasers
templates.description: Rewards and re-engages customers with a history of repeat purchases to keep them buying, using purchase frequency. Loyalty-tier logic runs in a Bloomreach evaluation outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer's purchase count crosses the repeat-purchaser threshold, send a retention email with a reward.

templates.name: Weather-influenced campaign
templates.description: Sends a promotional email tailored to the customer's local weather (for example rain gear before a rainy forecast). The page derives the city from session_start SDK events and a weather catalog fed by webhooks and automated imports, both outside this app's tracking model; only the send itself (customer email plus newsletter consent) is a tracking requirement.
templates.narrative_template: When the local forecast for a customer matches a weather trigger, send a weather-influenced promotional email.

templates.name: Welcome flow
templates.description: Sends a series of welcome emails to a newly subscribed customer, introducing the brand and encouraging a first purchase. Email cadence and content are configured in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer opts in to marketing emails, start a welcome email flow.

templates.name: Abandoned browse banner with recommendations
templates.description: Shows a web banner with recommended products to a returning visitor who previously browsed without buying, based on viewed items and a Bloomreach recommendation engine. The recommendation engine itself runs outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a returning visitor previously viewed products without purchasing, show a banner with recommended products.

templates.name: Abandoned browse banner
templates.description: Shows a returning visitor a web banner of the products they previously viewed, encouraging them to continue shopping. Banner display logic runs in Bloomreach's web personalization outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a returning visitor previously viewed products without purchasing, show a banner of their last viewed items.

templates.name: Abandoned cart banner
templates.description: Displays the products a customer left in their cart on a previous visit in a web banner, inviting them back to complete the purchase. Cart-contents retrieval uses a Bloomreach aggregate outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a returning visitor has items left in their cart, show a banner of the abandoned cart items.

default_requirements.note: Suppresses the banner once checkout has started.

templates.name: AI-segmented single opt-in email subscription banner
templates.description: Shows a single opt-in email subscription banner personalized by an AI-assigned visitor segment. Segment assignment runs in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For a visitor without newsletter consent, show a single opt-in subscription banner personalized to their segment.

templates.name: Banner notification for customers with high return rates
templates.description: The page title names a customer-level high-return audience, but its own "Understand the use case logic" section describes the same per-product trigger as UCC-web-06 (frequently returned items): a size or fit guidance banner shown on a product page for one of the top-10 most-returned products. This template follows the page body, not the title, and shares web-06's product-level requirements.
templates.narrative_template: When a viewed product is among the top-10 most-returned products, show a fit-guidance banner.

templates.name: Banner notification for frequently returned items
templates.description: Warns a shopper with a sizing or fit banner when they view a product with a high historical return rate. Item-level return-rate scoring runs in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a viewed product has a high historical return rate, show a fit-guidance banner.

templates.name: Birthday reminder banner
templates.description: Shows a birthday offer banner to a customer during their birthday period, using the stored birthday customer property. Offer content is configured in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: During a customer's birthday period, show a birthday offer banner.

templates.name: Browser tab animation
templates.description: Animates the browser tab title and favicon to recapture attention from a customer with an abandoned cart who has switched tabs. The animation asset itself is a Bloomreach web layer element outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer with items in their cart switches browser tabs, animate the tab to recapture attention.

templates.name: Cart consolidation banner
templates.description: Shows a banner reminding a customer of items already in their cart from a previous session, encouraging one consolidated checkout. Cart aggregation across sessions uses a Bloomreach aggregate outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer returns with items already in their cart, show a banner consolidating the cart contents.

templates.name: Customizable customer acquisition weblayer
templates.description: A configurable web layer aimed at first-time visitors to capture an email address or drive a first purchase. Layer design and targeting rules are configured in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For a visitor with no purchase history, show an acquisition web layer collecting an email address.

templates.name: Discount countdown banner
templates.description: Shows a countdown banner for a time-limited, site-wide discount to drive urgency. The page's trigger is any site visit while the discount is active, not a per-product view; only the catalog's own discount field is a tracking requirement, and the countdown timer itself is a Bloomreach web layer element outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: While a site-wide discount is active, show a countdown banner for it.

default_requirements.note: Only needed for a per-product variant of the banner.

templates.name: Easy access discount code banner
templates.description: Shows a persistent banner offering quick access to a discount code for eligible visitors. Eligibility rules (for example new-visitor or cart value) are configured in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For an eligible visitor, show a banner with quick access to a discount code.

templates.name: Gamified banners with email collection
templates.description: Shows a gamified spin-to-win banner that collects an email address in exchange for a discount code. Game mechanics run inside the Bloomreach web layer outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For a visitor without newsletter consent, show a gamified banner that collects their email in exchange for a discount.

templates.name: Gamified banners
templates.description: Shows a gamified spin-to-win style banner offering a discount code to increase engagement and conversion. Game mechanics run inside the Bloomreach web layer outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For an eligible visitor, show a gamified banner offering a discount code.

templates.name: Global and product-specific badges
templates.description: Shows trust or promotional badges site-wide or on specific product pages. The page requires the catalog's item_id plus custom boolean badge columns configured per client (for example a bestseller or eco flag); those custom columns are not expressible as a standard catalog field here and stay a Bloomreach Data Manager configuration step. Badge design itself is a web layer element outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a viewed product's catalog attributes match a badge rule, show the matching badge.

templates.name: Interactive post-purchase feedback banner
templates.description: Shows an interactive on-site feedback banner shortly after a purchase completes, collecting a satisfaction rating. Rating aggregation runs in a Bloomreach dashboard outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: Shortly after a purchase completes, show an interactive feedback banner.

templates.name: Interactive subscriber banner
templates.description: Shows an interactive banner inviting a visitor to subscribe to marketing emails in exchange for content or an offer. Banner interactivity runs in the Bloomreach web layer outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For a visitor without newsletter consent, show an interactive subscription banner.

templates.name: Location-based social proof banner
templates.description: Shows a social-proof banner referencing recent purchases near the visitor's location. The page matches the city of the customer's last session_start with the city of the last session_start before a purchase_item of the same product_id -- a session_start-derived city, not the customer's address property. Proximity matching and proof-copy generation run in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When nearby customers have recently purchased a viewed product, show a location-based social-proof banner.

templates.name: Multistep zero-party data banner
templates.description: Shows a multistep banner that progressively collects zero-party preference data from the visitor in exchange for personalization or an offer. Each step's answer is stored on the customer profile outside tracking's event model.
templates.narrative_template: For an eligible visitor, show a multistep banner collecting preference data.

templates.name: Next-day delivery countdown banner
templates.description: Shows a countdown banner for the cutoff time to qualify for next-day delivery on a product added to cart. Cutoff-time logic is a Bloomreach web layer element outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer adds a product eligible for next-day delivery to their cart, show a delivery-cutoff countdown banner.

templates.name: On-exit mobile banner
templates.description: Shows an exit-intent banner on mobile when a visitor with items in their cart is about to leave the site, offering an incentive to stay. Exit-intent detection is a Bloomreach web layer trigger outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a mobile visitor with items in their cart shows exit intent, show an on-exit banner.

templates.name: Previous searched destination reminder
templates.description: Reminds a returning visitor of a travel destination they viewed in the past seven days, shown as an on-site banner. The page's own logic section targets a recently viewed item, not a search; destination personalization runs in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a returning visitor viewed a destination in the past seven days without booking, show a reminder banner.

templates.name: Quiz banner with product recommendations
templates.description: Shows an interactive quiz banner that recommends products based on the visitor's answers. Quiz logic and the recommendation engine run inside the Bloomreach web layer outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For an eligible visitor, show a quiz banner that ends in personalized product recommendations.

templates.name: Recommendations carousel banner
templates.description: Shows a carousel banner of personalized product recommendations based on a visitor's browsing and purchase history. The recommendation engine runs outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For a visitor with browsing history, show a recommendations carousel banner.

templates.name: Single opt-in subscription banner
templates.description: Shows a simple single-field email subscription banner for visitors without marketing consent. Banner design and placement rules run in the Bloomreach web layer outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For a visitor without newsletter consent, show a single opt-in subscription banner.

templates.name: Social proof banner
templates.description: Shows a social-proof banner (for example "12 people bought this today") on product pages based on recent purchase activity for that product. Purchase-count aggregation runs in a Bloomreach aggregate outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a viewed product has recent purchase activity, show a social-proof banner.

templates.name: YouTube video banner
templates.description: Shows a banner embedding a YouTube product video on the product page to support the purchase decision. Video selection per product is configured in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer views a product with an associated video, show a video banner.

templates.name: Zero-party data banner
templates.description: Shows a banner that asks a visitor a single preference question to collect zero-party data used for later personalization. The collected preference is stored on the customer profile outside tracking's event model.
templates.narrative_template: For an eligible visitor, show a banner collecting one piece of zero-party preference data.

templates.name: Email and SMS reactivation campaign
templates.description: Reactivates a lapsed customer across email and SMS, choosing the channel by consent and past engagement, triggered from time since last purchase. Channel-selection logic runs in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer's time since last purchase crosses the reactivation threshold, send a reactivation message on their consented channel.

templates.name: Omnichannel abandoned cart flow
templates.description: Recovers an abandoned cart across web banner, email and SMS in sequence, escalating channel by consent and engagement. Channel sequencing and timing run in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer abandons a cart, run a web, email and SMS recovery sequence based on consent.

templates.name: Omnichannel post-purchase NPS survey
templates.description: Sends an NPS satisfaction survey after a purchase, on whichever channel (email or SMS) the customer has consented to. Score aggregation runs in a Bloomreach dashboard outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: After a purchase completes, send an NPS survey on the customer's consented channel.

templates.name: Personalized reengagement journey
templates.description: Runs a multi-step re-engagement journey across ad audiences, mobile push, email and SMS for repeat customers whose time since last purchase exceeds their typical buying cycle, offering a discount incentive. Journey branching logic runs in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a repeat customer's time since last purchase exceeds their typical cycle, run a personalized cross-channel re-engagement journey.

templates.name: Product expiration reminder
templates.description: Reminds a customer that a purchased product (for example a subscription, warranty or perishable item) is approaching expiration, using the purchase date and product_id. Expiration-window configuration per product runs in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: As a purchased product approaches its expiration window, send a reminder on the customer's consented channel.

templates.name: Reactivation campaign for promising and needs-attention segments
templates.description: Targets RFM-style "promising" and "needs attention" customer segments with a cross-channel reactivation offer, based on purchase recency and frequency. Segment scoring runs in a Bloomreach evaluation outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer falls into the promising or needs-attention RFM segment, send a cross-channel reactivation offer.

templates.name: Reactivation of lapsing customers with contextual personalization
templates.description: Reactivates customers who are starting to lapse with content personalized to their last browsed and purchased categories, across web and email. Contextual personalization logic runs in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer starts lapsing, send a contextually personalized reactivation message.

templates.name: RFM omnichannel winback campaign
templates.description: Wins back at-risk customers identified by an RFM (recency, frequency, monetary) score, with an offer delivered across email and SMS. RFM scoring runs in a Bloomreach evaluation outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer's RFM score crosses the at-risk threshold, send a cross-channel win-back offer.

templates.name: Abandoned browse SMS
templates.description: Sends an SMS reminder of recently viewed products to a customer who has SMS consent and left without purchasing. Message content is drawn from a Bloomreach aggregate of the last viewed items.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer with SMS consent views products without purchasing, send an abandoned-browse SMS.

templates.name: Mobile SMS subscription banner
templates.description: Shows a mobile web banner inviting a visitor to subscribe to SMS messaging in exchange for an offer. Banner design runs in the Bloomreach web layer outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For a mobile visitor without SMS consent, show a banner collecting SMS subscription.

templates.name: RCS interactive product recommendation flow
templates.description: Sends an interactive RCS message with a product-recommendation carousel to customers on RCS-capable devices. Carousel content is produced by a Bloomreach recommendation engine outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For a customer with SMS/RCS consent, send an interactive product-recommendation RCS message.

templates.name: SMS double opt-in subscription with zero-party data collection
templates.description: Runs a double opt-in SMS subscription flow that also collects a zero-party preference answer during confirmation. The confirmation flow itself runs in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For a visitor confirming SMS subscription, collect a zero-party preference during double opt-in.

templates.name: SMS subscription banner with offer
templates.description: Shows a banner offering a discount in exchange for SMS subscription. Banner design runs in the Bloomreach web layer outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For a visitor without SMS consent, show a banner offering a discount for subscribing.

templates.name: SMS subscription DOI checkout banner
templates.description: Shows a double opt-in SMS subscription banner during checkout, capturing the phone number at the moment of highest purchase intent. The trigger is placed at the checkout step.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer reaches checkout without SMS consent, show a double opt-in SMS subscription banner.

templates.name: SMS subscription via text evaluation
templates.description: Lets a visitor subscribe to SMS by texting a keyword, evaluated by an inbound message handler. Keyword evaluation runs in Bloomreach outside this app's tracking scope.
templates.narrative_template: When a visitor texts the subscription keyword, mark them as SMS subscribed.

templates.name: SMS subscription with email collection
templates.description: Collects both an SMS opt-in and an email address in one banner flow, maximizing addressable channels from a single interaction. Banner flow logic runs in the Bloomreach web layer outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For a visitor without SMS or newsletter consent, show a banner collecting both.

templates.name: Welcome SMS
templates.description: Sends a welcome SMS to a customer immediately after they subscribe to SMS messaging. Message content and timing are configured in Bloomreach outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: When a customer subscribes to SMS, send a welcome SMS.

templates.name: WhatsApp interactive product recommendation flow
templates.description: Sends an interactive WhatsApp message with product recommendations to customers who have SMS/WhatsApp consent. Recommendation content is produced by a Bloomreach recommendation engine outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: For a customer with SMS consent, send an interactive WhatsApp product-recommendation message.

templates.name: CLTV-based lookalike targeting for paid ads
templates.description: Builds a lookalike ad audience from high customer-lifetime-value customers to acquire similar new customers via paid ads. CLTV scoring and the ad-platform sync run in Bloomreach outside tracking; only the underlying purchase history and consent are tracking requirements.
templates.narrative_template: Build a paid-ad lookalike audience from customers with purchase history and retargeting consent.

templates.name: Paid ad optimization using audience predictions
templates.description: Optimizes paid-ad spend by targeting audiences predicted to convert, based on purchase and browsing history feeding a Bloomreach prediction. The prediction model itself runs outside tracking; only the underlying events are tracking requirements.
templates.narrative_template: Build a paid-ad audience from customers with purchase and browsing history and retargeting consent.

templates.name: Paid ads optimized for email engagement
templates.description: Targets paid ads at customers based on their email engagement level, syncing an email-engaged audience to the ad platform. Engagement scoring runs in a Bloomreach evaluation outside tracking.
templates.narrative_template: Build a paid-ad audience from customers with high email engagement and retargeting consent.

templates.name: Social media ad audiences
templates.description: Syncs customer segments (for example recent purchasers or cart abandoners) to social-media ad platforms as custom audiences. The ad-platform sync itself runs in Bloomreach outside tracking; only the underlying events are tracking requirements.
templates.narrative_template: Build a social-media ad audience from customers matching a purchase or cart-abandonment segment.

templates.name: Apple Mail segmentation dashboard
templates.description: Reports email performance segmented by Apple Mail Privacy Protection status, so open-rate metrics are not skewed by MPP. Only the newsletter consent and customer email are tracking requirements; the dashboard itself is a Bloomreach analytics asset.
templates.narrative_template: Report email performance segmented by Apple Mail Privacy Protection status.

templates.name: Black Friday dashboard
templates.description: A seasonal dashboard tracking purchase volume and revenue through the Black Friday period against the standard purchase events. The dashboard's date filters and visuals are a Bloomreach analytics asset.
templates.narrative_template: Report purchase volume and revenue for the Black Friday period.

templates.name: Conversion dashboard
templates.description: Reports the funnel from view_item through add_to_cart to purchase, showing revenue per visitor, average order value and revenue at each step. The dashboard's funnel visualization is a Bloomreach analytics asset.
templates.narrative_template: Report the view-to-cart-to-purchase conversion funnel.

templates.name: Customer lifetime value dashboard
templates.description: Reports customer lifetime value computed from purchase history, segmented by acquisition channel or cohort. CLTV computation itself is a Bloomreach prediction outside tracking; only the underlying purchase events are tracking requirements.
templates.narrative_template: Report customer lifetime value computed from purchase history.

templates.name: Email deliverability dashboard
templates.description: Reports email deliverability health (bounce and complaint indicators) alongside subscriber consent status. Deliverability metrics themselves come from the ESP integration outside tracking; only consent and email are tracking requirements.
templates.narrative_template: Report email deliverability health for the newsletter-consented subscriber base.

templates.name: Email performance dashboard
templates.description: Reports on the newsletter-consented active subscriber base and resulting purchases. Campaign-level open/click metrics are a Bloomreach analytics asset.
templates.narrative_template: Report on the active subscriber base and resulting purchases.

templates.name: Executive dashboard
templates.description: A high-level executive summary of revenue and subscriber growth across channels. The dashboard's layout and rollups are a Bloomreach analytics asset; only the underlying events are tracking requirements.
templates.narrative_template: Report top-line revenue and subscriber growth.

templates.name: Key customer segments and insights dashboard
templates.description: Reports the size and behaviour of key customer segments (for example by purchase frequency or recency) built from purchase history. Segment definitions are a Bloomreach analytics asset; only the underlying purchase events are tracking requirements.
templates.narrative_template: Report the size and behaviour of key customer segments built from purchase history.

templates.name: Returned items dashboard
templates.description: Reports the volume and rate of returned items against total purchases, broken down by product. The dashboard's breakdown views are a Bloomreach analytics asset.
templates.narrative_template: Report returned-item volume and rate against total purchases.

templates.name: Subscriber and unsubscriber monitoring dashboard
templates.description: Tracks newsletter subscriber growth and unsubscribe trends over time, based on the newsletter consent state. The trend visualization is a Bloomreach analytics asset.
templates.narrative_template: Report newsletter subscriber growth and unsubscribe trends.

templates.name: Time zone segmentation
templates.description: Segments customers by inferred time zone (from address) to time campaign sends for local relevance. Time-zone inference itself is a Bloomreach evaluation outside tracking; only the customer's address is a tracking requirement.
templates.narrative_template: Segment customers by inferred time zone for local send-time optimization.

templates.name: RFM customer segmentation
templates.description: Segments all customers with at least one successful purchase by recency, frequency and monetary value into a best-practice RFM segment (Champions, Loyal, At risk, and so on), stored as a customer property. The score computation and segment-table lookup are a Bloomreach scenario and 18 supporting customer attributes outside tracking; only the qualifying purchase itself is a tracking requirement.
templates.narrative_template: For every customer with at least one successful purchase, compute and store an RFM segment on their profile.
